title: Career Roadmap · Dairy Technician
summary: A Dairy Technician operates and monitors milk-processing equipment, supports pasteurisation and packaging, checks product quality, and maintains hygiene and safety in dairy plants.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Dairy Technology / Food Technology / related technical field

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Science; Biology or Mathematics may be useful depending on the programme.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Chemistry, biology, mathematics, microbiology and basic engineering.

blocks.label: Entrance/admission
blocks.text: State polytechnic entrance or merit-based admission, depending on the institution.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Milk collection, pasteurisation, chilling, fermentation, cheese, butter and packaging.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Hygiene, accurate measurement, equipment handling, teamwork and recordkeeping.

items.text: Diploma in Dairy Technology → Dairy Processing Technician, Milk Plant Operator.
Diploma in Food Technology → Dairy production, packaging and quality-support roles.
Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering → Dairy equipment operation and maintenance.
B.Tech Dairy Technology → Dairy processing, production and quality-related roles.
B.Tech / B.Sc. Food Technology → Food processing, product development and quality assurance, depending on employer requirements.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Recognised prior qualification, transcripts, English proficiency where required, prerequisite subjects and visa documentation. Diploma-to-degree credit transfer varies; postgraduate programmes usually have specific academic prerequisites.
Verify current programme availability and admission criteria directly with each institution.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Dairy Processing Technician, Dairy Plant Operator, Quality Control Technician, Packaging Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Dairy manufacturing, cheese and fermented foods, food packaging and cold-chain logistics.
Employment, qualification recognition and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.
Diploma Student ↓ Production Trainee ↓ Dairy Technician ↓ Senior Dairy / Processing Technician ↓ Shift Supervisor / Quality Supervisor ↓ Dairy Plant Operations Manager / Technical Specialist
Progression depends on experience, qualification level and employer requirements.
